title: Hormones in Plants and Animals
summary: Tropisms and plant hormones, and the human endocrine glands and feedback.
objectives: I can explain phototropism and geotropism using auxin.
I can name endocrine glands and their hormones.
I can describe feedback control of a hormone.
misconceptions: Plants can’t respond to their surroundings.
Hormones act as fast as nerves.
The Mimosa leaf folds by growing.
